title: Bug repair and verification workflow
question: Which repair and proof boundaries prevent repeated editor defects without duplicate rules, proxy completion or compulsory publication?
prerequisiteReason: Workflow proof selection can be assessed without revisiting product architecture.

opportunity.reason: Repeated user-reported interaction regressions expose contradictory proof selection and local completion rules.

gaps: No executable check covers the bug-fix workflow itself; each fix is proven per case through Verify Plate.
